items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Doesn't practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Chase (knee) was present but not suited up at Wednesday's practice, Gabi Sorrentino of Fox 19 Cincinnati reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tee Higgins: No practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Higgins (heel) didn't take part in practice Wednesday, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Resumes running
items.body_text: Fellow RB D'Andre Swift said Monangai (knee) "looked good" while running Wednesday, Adam Hoge of AllCHGO.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Khalil Shakir: Optimism regarding Week 1
items.body_text: Per Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com, "there's currently optimism" that Shakir (undisclosed) will be available Week 1 against the Texans on Sunday, Sept. 13 Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Handles individual, team drills Wednesday
items.body_text: Coach John Harbaugh said Nabers (knee) participated in individual and team drills at Wednesday's practice, Connor Hughes of SNY.tv reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
